scenicChapters.title: Sicily Etna Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 26 km this is Sicily Etna Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

sicily-etna-scenic-road.story: From Catania it runs 111 km to Taormina; allow about 1 h 32 of riding. On the way it passes Nicolosi, Rifugio Sapienza and Zafferana Etnea. The highest point is about 1,100 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

legend-bregenzerwald-cheese-road.story: official tourism route. Alpine farms, villages, mountains. A one-way ride of 45 km, Bregenz to Warth - roughly 49 min in the saddle. It goes by way of Egg, Bezau and Schoppernau. The highest point is about 1,950 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Bregenzerwald Cheese Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 12 km this is Bregenzerwald Cheese Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
